## Hypothesis

We are analyzing the top keeper from the shotgun_scalper_stage2 grinder output (wide_pnl=15706.5, edge_capture=-36.0, WR=0.57) to determine if it has genuine edge on the J anchor days and whether it should be promoted to the leaderboard. ## Mechanism

The keeper uses the following parameters:
- tp_premium_pct: 0.5 (exit at 50% premium gain)
- stop_premium_pct: -0.3 (exit at 30% premium loss)
- time_stop_min: 10 (exit after 10 minutes if not stopped)
- strike_offset: 2 (OTM-2 strike for puts, bearish context)
- chandelier_arm_pct: 0.5 (chandelier profit lock arms at 50% gain)
- vol_ratio_threshold: 1.2 (require volume >= 1.2 * average volume)

The strategy is applied to the shotgun_scalper setup (assumed to be a variant of BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON or similar). Entry logic likely triggers on volume-expansion breakouts with strict 10-minute time stops and tight premium-based stops/profits.
